status: LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION PASS / NOT DEPLOYED / NO INDEPENDENT REVIEW
claim: The purpose vault and the covenant's aggregate market-capacity rule are implemented in one program and enforced by the compiled SBF under LiteSVM. Nothing here was sent to any cluster.

program.name: purpose_vault
program.rebuild_determinism: two consecutive local builds after touching a source file produced the same digest; this is a same-host check only and does not establish a verified build

parity_vector.note: each vault is individually under the ceiling; together they exceed it by 333333 base units, which is the case the aggregate rule exists for

defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_buil.symptom: ReleasePurpose::try_accounts stack frame 4672 bytes against the 4096 SBF limit, over by 296
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_buil.severity: the compiler states this may cause undefined behaviour at runtime; it is not a style warning
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_buil.fix: boxed the seven deserialized accounts in that context so they live on the heap
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_buil.regression_guard: the purpose-vault-b2 CI job fails if the build log contains a stack-offset report

defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_buil.symptom: assert! over compile-time constants is optimised out, so the headline invariant was not actually being checked
defects_found_and_fixed_during_this_buil.fix: the unit test now asserts over values returned by the policy functions; the integration test uses const _: () = assert!(..) so the relation is checked at compile time

known_limits: not deployed to localnet, devnet, testnet or mainnet
no published IDL: the Anchor CLI cannot run on the build host because of a glibc mismatch, and a hand-assembled IDL was deliberately not shipped
the deployed B1 program cannot debit a B2 capacity window; a complete aggregate guarantee requires both pools to live in B2
market_capacity_bps and the definition of eligible volume are test parameters, not frozen production values
the oracle and the approver are single keys; no multisig and no treasury signers exist
if the oracle key is lost, no further release is possible and deposits stay locked; this is the accepted conservative failure direction
purpose truthfulness is not verified on chain and is not claimed
